So each bot's cost lands on the right team and project.

fields: The cloud cost export that includes your AI services. Used for invoice-level cost, commitments and credits.
Where the cloud writes the export.
Read-only access to that location. A role or managed identity is recommended: no long-lived secret.
Read AI service lines only (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
Keeps unrelated cloud cost out of Token IQ.
Cloud billing export.after: Token IQ reads the latest export and every new one as it arrives (usually daily).

fields: A name for this source, shown across Token IQ.
vendor, internal system, reseller or your own app
Who provides the data. Anything works: an internal gateway, a reseller, a regional provider, an in-house platform, or one of your own applications.
Your application sends usage (OpenTelemetry or webhook)
Scheduled file drop (SFTP, S3, Azure Blob, email)
Manual CSV upload with a template

How data moves. Pull: Token IQ calls their API on a schedule. Sends usage: the system or your own application pushes each record to Token IQ as OpenTelemetry gen_ai spans or JSON webhooks, using an ingest token Token IQ creates for it. File drop: CSV or JSON files on a schedule. Database: a read-only query against a view. Manual: someone uploads a file each month.
Depends on the style: the API URL to call, the folder or bucket to read, or the database host. Leave blank when the system sends usage: Token IQ gives you the address and ingest token to send with.
How Token IQ proves who it is, or how it checks that pushed data is genuine. Use OAuth 2.0 or mutual TLS where the system supports it.
The secret for the chosen method. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

Tell Token IQ where each standard field is in their record (a JSON path or CSV column). Only timestamp, model and token counts are required; if cost is missing, Token IQ prices it at your effective rates.
Paste one real record. The Configure tab shows how Token IQ reads it before you save.
How often Token IQ pulls, or when it processes pushed data.
Team for records with no user or project.
Custom source.after: Token IQ tests the connection and parses your sample record into the standard fields. Records from this source are labelled "Custom" with their evidence level (reported cost, or priced by Token IQ), and appear in Raw records exactly as received.

member.title: Manage member
member.intro: Set what one person in your team can use. Changes apply immediately and are recorded in Team activity.
fields: Only people in your team are listed.
The member and you are notified at 80% and 100%. The total of limits can exceed the team budget; the team budget alert still applies.
Models this person's keys may use. Premium models for development keys need a reason.
Projects this person can create keys for and whose usage they appear in.
Suspended: the person's keys stop working and they cannot sign in to team pages. Use for leave or offboarding.
Email the member a summary of this change
member.after: The member sees the new limit and models in My Usage › Limits & access. Suspending revokes their keys within a minute.

addmember.title: Add member to team
addmember.intro: Add an existing employee to your team. They join as a Team Member (read-only, own usage). Other roles are granted by the Org Admin.
fields: Must already be in the company directory.
Starting limit. Your team default is $150.
addmember.after: The person is notified and sees their usage in My Usage. If they belong to another team, that Team Lead is told about the move.

project.title: Create project
project.intro: A project is an application or workload in your team. Keys belong to projects, so every request's cost is allocated.
fields: As your team refers to it.
The person responsible for the project's cost.
Must fit within the team budget's unassigned amount ($0 left: request an increase first).
One key is suggested per environment.
project.after: The project appears in Projects & Keys and Cost Explorer. Create its first virtual key next.

request.title: New approval request
request.intro: Ask for a budget increase, a new project or access to a model. The right approver is selected automatically.
fields: Budget increases go to Finance; model access and projects go to the Org Admin.
Team Leads can only request for their own team.
Approvers decide faster with a clear reason and the expected impact.
request.after: The approver is notified. You can track the request in Policies & Approvals.

integration.title: Connect integration
integration.intro: Send recommendations, alerts and reports to the tools your teams already use.
integration.after: You are redirected to the tool to approve access, then returned here.
